approvals.rationale: EmDash spike integration rebased onto main 771762e: these are additive response-only fields, not new caller requirements. Core supplies publication state for campaign editing, the authenticated user's email for the shared CMS identity, and authoritative order line quantities for the Astro confirmation. Existing response properties and request contracts remain intact. The generated client ships with the matching Core release; this does not promise compatibility with an older Core server. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Delivery planning adds an output-only list to the authenticated privacy subject report. Core always serializes orderDeliveries, including an empty list when no deliveries exist. Existing response fields and all existing request requirements remain unchanged. The generated client ships with the matching Core release. This exact-hash approval covers the additive response field only, not compatibility with an older Core server.

Campaign modularity: campaign types become data. Template keys widen from the closed enum blank|krapfentaxi to validated slugs that must exist in the template catalogue, and the capability enum gains 'delivery' (previously implied by the Krapfentaxi template key). CreatePublicOrderRequest.deliveryRecipient becomes optional because Core now requires it only for actions with the delivery capability; existing callers that send it are unaffected. New response fields (presentationTheme, public capabilities, per-unit quantities) are always serialized and only added; box totals stay and are marked deprecated. The generated client ships with the matching Core release; clients that switch exhaustively over the old enums must accept the new values. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Manager delivery completion (PR #47, port of #3) adds an output-only optimistic version to every commitment response. Core always serializes it; clients send it back unchanged to completeCommitmentDelivery. Existing response properties and all request contracts remain intact. The generated client ships with the matching Core release. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Inbox module (port of PR #7, step 7): the privacy subject report gains the response-only reference type 'inbox_case' so system administrators see inbox cases of a data subject. Existing values are unchanged; the only client, the generated TypeScript client and the privacy admin view, is updated in the same change and labels the new type.

Leitsystem shell (Task 4.1): the identity response gains the output-only installation object with the club name (LEONAID_CLUB_NAME, one club per installation) that the admin rail and the PWA show. Core always serializes it; no request contract changes and every existing response field stays. A cached older web or PWA bundle ignores the extra property. The generated client ships with the matching Core release; this does not promise compatibility with an older Core server. Approved by Björn Schotte on 2026-11-04. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and this change.

Leitsystem milestone 2, approved by Björn Schotte on 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05. Survey analysis applies the k = 5 disclosure rule to every aggregate for all viewers: counts become nullable when withheld, and QuestionAggregate.sum is removed because a sum leaks withheld answers; raw exports are unchanged. MemberDirectoryActionResponse.leadRequired tells the member page when an action needs a lead. The dashboard (delivery, orderValueWeeks), invoice dashboard (deliveryFailed, overdue, overdueAmountMinor) and delivery window (fullyBooked) fields are additive, always-serialized response data. The generated client ships with the matching Core release; this does not promise compatibility with an older Core server. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Multi-domain stage 1b adds landingPath, the role-based start page computed by Core for the signed-in member, to the authenticated identity response. It is output-only: Core always serializes it, and no request contract changes. The generated client ships with the matching Core release; this does not promise compatibility with an older Core server. Approved by Björn Schotte on 2026-11-07. Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Offline queue stage 1 adds the feature flag key pwa.offline_queue. Only the literal set of response-only flag keys grows; no request contract or existing value changes. The generated client ships with the matching Core release. Approved by Björn Schotte on 2026-11-08 (lead decision log E-009). Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

The inbox closing note must have at least 10 characters on the server too. The web UI already enforced this, so its requests do not change; any other client could close a case with one character, which was a bug. Approved by Björn Schotte on 2026-11-08 (E-032). Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Adding the feature flag key delivery.tours widens the FeatureFlagKeyValue enum in two responses. Clients that read flag keys treat unknown keys as off (the generated client and the apps only look up known keys), so this is additive in practice. Decided by the lead under Björn's standing delegation on 2026-11-09 (spec specs/krapfentaxi-touren D14a, same as the earlier pwa.offline_queue flag). Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.

Delivery tours slice 2 (specs/krapfentaxi-touren §5, §6.4, §11, D11, D14 b) adds response fields only: the stop coordinates (lat/lon), the action's start point and the map tiles in the tour reads, the start point in the delivery configuration, and the coordinates in the privacy report (Task 9). They are always present (null when unknown), so the generator marks them required. No field is removed or narrowed and no request gets stricter: startPoint in the configuration request is optional and its absence keeps the stored value. The only clients are the generated client and the apps of this repository, regenerated in the same change. Ratified by the lead under Björn's standing delegation on 2026-11-09 (task review of delivery tours Task 10). Approval is bound to these exact contract hashes and changes.
